title: AdjudicateRequest
description: Consumer-side final resolution shared back to the gateway. Resolution happens in the system that plugs into SCINTX results (registry UI, ticketing, etc.); this request records that outcome for audit and delivery.

decision.description: Final gate outcome. review and defer are not valid here.

actor.description: Who resolved it (email, service account, bot id).

source.description: External system where resolution happened, e.g. registry-ui, jira, github-app.

expires_at.description: Optional expiry for a temporary exception.

extensions.description: Opaque consumer fields copied onto the stored PolicyDecision.extensions.
